yaml_imported.title: Somfy CUL: YAML configuration imported
yaml_imported.description:
The Somfy CUL configuration from configuration.yaml has been imported. The CUL and the covers can now be managed in the UI under Settings → Devices & services → Somfy CUL.

The YAML configuration keeps working: covers added there are imported at startup. Covers that already exist are not changed by YAML anymore, edit them in the UI instead. You can remove the `somfy_cul` and `cover` entries from configuration.yaml to get rid of this message.

yaml_import_failed.title: Somfy CUL: YAML configuration could not be imported
yaml_import_failed.description: The Somfy CUL configuration for {cul_path} could not be imported ({reason}). Check the configuration or set up the integration in the UI.
